skipped.evidence: 摘要主体是一项社会科学实验研究：'controlled, IRB-approved, five-day experiment with participants interacting on a social media platform infiltrated by RL-trained bots spreading disinformation'，并在 'cybersecurity settings including Covert Social Influence Operations (CSIOs)' 语境下比较 'humans, AI models, and hybrid Human-AI ensembles in detecting adaptive bots'。其核心是用 13 个假设、6 个 bot 检测器做人类行为与检测率的人因/网络安全研究（人口学、社会网络位置、集体智慧机制），并非多模态 / post-training / 生成式 / 世界模型方向的算法方法论文，与算法实习求职方向无关。

摘要为无线感知与传感器融合的可复现性研究：'We investigate whether ambient WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) can substitute for a body-worn inertial measurement unit (IMU) in human activity recognition (HAR)'，结论为 'Under a controlled, multi-seed evaluation, WiFi is systematically weak: every backbone we try reaches 6-11% weighted accuracy on the 27-class set, against 73-80% for IMU'。其核心是 WiFi CSI 表征修复、受试者独立评测与 CSI-IMU 门控融合的对比，属无线感知/人体活动识别领域；标题中的 'Multimodal' 仅指传感器模态融合，与多模态算法 / post-training / 生成式 / 世界模型方向无实质技术关联。
